text:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT 1864012345 - embeddings-hot-route spike. qps 3.2k (baseline 700), errors 4.8%, latency p95 > 2.5s. Affected endpoints: /v1/embeddings, /v1/chat?mode=rerank

maya: paging oncall. i'm the responder. starting triage.

sophia: thx. looks like a sustained embeddings surge from a few heavy customers + a bursty public dataset job. can we do a quick per-endpoint carve? prioritise chat low-latency customers.

eli: confirmed two customers (cust-omega, cust-datahub) account for ~55% of extra qps. rerank traffic also spiking but smaller tail. errors look like 429 + upstream throttles.

maya: mitigation plan proposal (short window):
1) rate-limit embeddings route global qps -> 1200 (was unlimited for some routes)
2) per-customer soft cap: cust-datahub -> 250 qps, cust-omega -> 400 qps
3) reduce rerank concurrency: rerank model for non-enterprise -> fallback model rnk-v1b
4) enable prefix KV cache for embeddings-heavy model to reduce compute
5) open fallback region (us-west-warm) for 30% of new embeddings requests

ryan: +1. do we have CLI for quick toggle? i'll run the throttle commands if someone posts them.

ops-sre: posting safe commands now. running steps are reversible, tested on staging.

ops-sre: 
```
# set per-route global qps
infractl quota set --route embeddings --qps 1200 --reason "live mitigation 1864012345"

# carve per-customer
infractl quota set --route embeddings --customer cust-datahub --qps 250
infractl quota set --route embeddings --customer cust-omega --qps 400

# switch rerank model for public tier
rbctl route update --route rerank --model rnk-v1b --filter "tier:public"

# enable KV prefix cache for model-id: emb-3
rbctl model cache enable --model emb-3 --mode prefix
```

eli: i'll verify counters after each step. maya, want me to run these?

maya: please run them, call out when each completes. i'll monitor error rate and latency and coordinate customer comms.

ops-sre: running step 1 (global qps -> 1200) now.

ops-sre: done. infractl job 672341 queued -> applied.

eli: seeing drop in qps to ~1.1k incoming on embeddings, errors down to 2.1%, p95 latency improved to 1.6s. good.

ops-sre: applying per-customer caps. cust-datahub -> 250 applied.

ryan: cust-datahub is reporting retries but service remains up. any customer-facing note?

maya: draft note: "We're observing elevated embeddings traffic causing transient throttles. We've applied temporary per-endpoint and per-customer limits to stabilize service. If you're seeing 429s, please retry with exponential backoff; enterprise customers on paid tiers are prioritized. We're investigating root cause and will update in 30m." can someone post to status?

sophia: i'll post to status.redwood.com and link here. add mention that we switched rerank model for public tier.

ops-sre: cust-omega cap -> 400 applied.

eli: enabling rerank fallback for public tier now. rbctl job 99321 started.

ops-sre: enabled KV prefix cache for emb-3.

maya: observations after all actions: overall qps back to baseline ~750-900, errors ~0.9%, p95 ~1.2s. embedding throughput per-tenant stable. rerank latency increased slightly for public but within SLO.

ryan: good. i'm going to reach out to cust-omega ops to warn about the soft cap and offer an escalation path.

maya: handoff: eli, can you take second-shift until 22:00 PT and run follow-up/root-cause? i'll badge this as mitigated and keep monitor for next 2 hours.

eli: i'll take it. creating follow-up ticket: INC-1864012345-rca. assign to eng-ml + infra.

oncall-bot: :white_check_mark: INCIDENT 1864012345 - mitigation applied, status: degraded -> stabilizing. responders: maya, eli, ops-sre. follow-up: INC-1864012345-rca.

maya: closing thread here. please update the RCA ticket with logs, traffic fingerprints, and suggestion for automatic per-customer throttles for future surges. :thumbsup:
